zh: 修复旧 MathType 编号与跨段落引用书签的兼容问题，以及编号失败后的部分写入。取消编辑和引用选择不再预先修改全文编号；失败时恢复正文与编号设置。改善长文档导航、快照复用、App 启动和预览调度，并更新彩色工作台、模板分类及窄窗口布局。
en: Fixes legacy MathType numbering with enclosing reference bookmarks and partial writes after numbering failures. Cancelling an editor or reference selection no longer upgrades document numbering in advance; failures restore document edits and numbering settings. Improves long-document navigation, snapshot reuse, app startup and preview scheduling, and refreshes the colorful workbench, template categories and narrow-window layout.
